runtime_retired: A model trained on microscopy rather than photographs. OpenPhenom and ChAda-ViT take any number of stains; SubCell takes two, DNA then the stain of interest, in the order the channels are encoded. Weights download once. Cell-DINO's weights are not published yet. Default None (use the backbone).
runtime_added: A model trained on microscopy rather than photographs. OpenPhenom and ChAda-ViT take any number of stains; SubCell takes two, DNA then the stain of interest, in the order the channels are encoded. Weights download once. Cell-DINO needs an official checkpoint and is not yet supported by this version. Default None (use the backbone).
